lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Town Council's June 30th first reading of Land Use Code amendments tied to Colorado's wildfire resilience requirements — real changes to how buildings get built in a box canyon that knows fire. Council also holds a second work session on Telluride's Energy Mitigation program that same evening, while the Housing Authority meets to seat its new Resident Advisory Committee and conduct a tenant drawing across five properties.

notable.stake: First reading: wildfire code changes that affect how all buildings are built here.
THA appoints new Resident Advisory Committee; tenant drawing affects housing placements.
